node.label: Uniform Civil Code
node.summary: Article 44 and States adopting a Uniform Civil Code.

facts.text: **Article 44** (Directive Principle) asks the State to secure a Uniform Civil Code. **Uttarakhand** became the first State to implement a UCC on **27 Jan 2025**; **Goa** has had a common civil code since Portuguese rule.
facts.plain: Article 44 (Directive Principle) asks the State to secure a Uniform Civil Code. Uttarakhand became the first State to implement a UCC on 27 Jan 2025; Goa has had a common civil code since Portuguese rule.

facts.text: Union Home Minister **Amit Shah** said a **Uniform Civil Code** will be implemented in **U.P.** if the BJP wins the 2027 Assembly election; he recalled the **30 Oct 1990** firing on kar sevaks in Ayodhya ordered by then CM Mulayam Singh Yadav.
